description:
Fix build errors in a Maven project in Eclipse IDE. The project files are located at ~/eclipse-workspace/gs-maven-broken/ but need to be imported into Eclipse first.

Your task:
1. Import the existing Maven project from ~/eclipse-workspace/gs-maven-broken/ into Eclipse (File > Import > Existing Maven Projects)
2. Once imported, you will see build errors because a dependency is missing
3. Examine the errors to identify what dependency is needed (hint: check what imports fail)
4. Edit pom.xml to add the required dependency
5. Save the file and update the Maven project to download dependencies
6. Verify the project compiles successfully without errors
